lines.en: Welcome to the museum, Mia. Did you read the rules at the door?
lines.pt: Bem-vindo ao museu, Mia. Você leu as regras na porta?

lines.en: Yes. The sign said we could take photos, but not with a flash.
lines.pt: Sim. A placa dizia que podíamos tirar fotos, mas sem flash.

lines.en: Correct. The guide said that we could touch the old tools, but only with gloves.
lines.pt: Correto. O guia disse que podíamos tocar nas ferramentas antigas, mas só de luvas.

lines.en: Interesting. Yesterday the man at the desk told me that we could bring water inside.
lines.pt: Interessante. Ontem o homem da recepção me disse que podíamos levar água para dentro.

lines.en: Well, he said that bottles could stay in your bag, not in the rooms.
lines.pt: Bem, ele disse que as garrafas podiam ficar na bolsa, não nas salas.

lines.en: Oh, I see. My friend said that children could enter for free on Sundays.
lines.pt: Ah, entendi. Meu amigo disse que crianças podiam entrar de graça aos domingos.

lines.en: That is true. The website said that kids under twelve could come in for free.
lines.pt: É verdade. O site dizia que crianças com menos de doze anos podiam entrar de graça.

lines.en: Great. And the guard told us that we could sit on the benches near the window.
lines.pt: Ótimo. E o guarda nos disse que podíamos sentar nos bancos perto da janela.

lines.en: Yes, you could rest there. She said that the shop closed at five.
lines.pt: Sim, vocês podiam descansar ali. Ela disse que a loja fechava às cinco.

lines.en: Then we have time. The woman said that the film started at two.
lines.pt: Então temos tempo. A mulher disse que o filme começava às duas.

lines.en: Right, and she said you could ask questions after the film. Enjoy!
lines.pt: Certo, e ela disse que vocês podiam fazer perguntas depois do filme. Divirtam-se!

facts.big: The guide said we could take photos
facts.label: Said + could
facts.sub: Use said (that) + could para repetir regras: The guide said we could… Com a pessoa que ouviu, use told: He told me that…

facts.label: disse que podia
facts.sub: Use said (that) + could para repetir o que alguém falou sobre permissão: The guide said we could take photos. O can do que a pessoa disse vira could.

facts.label: me disse que…
facts.sub: Com told, vem a pessoa: He told me that we could bring water. Não use said me. Pode dizer: He said that… ou He said to me that…

compare.ask: The guide said we could take photos.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “O guia disse que podíamos tirar fotos”.
compare.tip: Diga: “The guide said we could take photos.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use said (that) + could: The guide said we could take photos. Com a pessoa que ouve, use told: He told me that we could. Não use “said me”.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.

extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The guide said we could take photos reports what the guide said.
Can becomes could in reported speech.
We say “He said me that we could…”
items.why: We say he told me that… or he said that…

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The guide said we could take photos reports what the guide said. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Can becomes could in reported speech. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “He said me that we could…” → Falso (We say he told me that… or he said that…)

pages.title: A museum in Dublin · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy afternoon in Dublin. Max waits outside a big museum. His friend Emma comes out to meet him. She has already been inside for an hour. There are many signs on the wall. Max wants to know the rules.

“Welcome to the museum, Max. Did you read the rules at the door?” says Emma. “Yes. The sign said we could take photos, but not with a flash.” says Max. “Correct. The guide said that we could touch the old tools, but only with gloves.” says Emma.
